questions.explanation: 破折号后列举了“早婚、不安全、女性缺乏言论自由”，这些都属于社会对女性的不公平对待，故选injustices（不公正）。demands要求；elements要素；functions功能，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(demands): 语境句：The workers' demands for higher pay were eventually met by the company. 固定搭配：meet demands, make demands
B(elements): 语境句：Honesty and hard work are the essential elements of success. 固定搭配：essential elements, key elements
C(injustices): 语境句：The documentary exposes the social injustices suffered by minority groups. 固定搭配：suffer injustices, fight against injustices
D(functions): 语境句：The heart has the important function of pumping blood around the body. 固定搭配：bodily functions, perform a function

questions.explanation: 根据后文“establishing future profession（建立未来的职业）”可知，她对未来的“职业（occupation）”感到迷茫。marriage婚姻；security安全；wealth财富，均与后文的profession不呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(marriage): 语境句：They celebrated their 50th year of happy marriage last week. 固定搭配：arranged marriage, early marriage
B(security): 语境句：Job security is a major concern for many young graduates today. 固定搭配：national security, job security
C(wealth): 语境句：He accumulated great wealth through his successful business ventures. 固定搭配：accumulate wealth, create wealth
D(occupation): 语境句：Please state your name, age, and occupation on the application form. 固定搭配：choose an occupation, main occupation

questions.explanation: 句意为这个在线学习项目“包含”许多科目。comprise表“包含、由……组成”，可直接加宾语（A comprises B）；若用compose，需用被动形式be composed of。lack缺乏；limit限制，不符合语意。
questions.supplement:
A(composed): 语境句：The committee is composed of experts from various fields. 固定搭配：be composed of, stay composed
B(comprised): 语境句：The medical team comprised five doctors and ten nurses. 固定搭配：comprise of (非正式), be comprised of
C(lacked): 语境句：He lacked the necessary skills for the job and was rejected. 固定搭配：lack experience, lack confidence
D(limited): 语境句：Our resources are limited, so we must use them wisely. 固定搭配：be limited to, limited time

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“so she ... the opportunity to take part in it”可知，她把“参与（participation）”这个项目视为建立未来职业的关键。evaluation评估；identification识别；competition竞争。
questions.supplement:
A(evaluation): 语境句：The students' performance will be subject to continuous evaluation. 固定搭配：performance evaluation, conduct an evaluation
B(identification): 语境句：Please carry some form of identification with you at all times. 固定搭配：personal identification, identification card
C(competition): 语境句：She faced fierce competition from other candidates for the position. 固定搭配：fierce competition, enter a competition
D(participation): 语境句：Active participation in class discussions is highly encouraged. 固定搭配：active participation, encourage participation

questions.explanation: 因为她视此为建立职业的关键，所以她“迫不及待地接受/抓住（jumped at）”这个机会。turn down拒绝；miss out错过；look for寻找。
questions.supplement:
A(jumped at): 语境句：When offered the chance to study abroad, she jumped at it. 固定搭配：jump at the chance, jump at the opportunity
B(turned down): 语境句：He turned down the job offer because the salary was too low. 固定搭配：turn down an offer, turn down a request
C(missed out): 语境句：If you don't come to the party, you'll miss out on all the fun. 固定搭配：miss out on, not want to miss out
D(looked for): 语境句：He has been looking for his lost keys all morning. 固定搭配：look for a job, look for help

questions.explanation: “make a decision lightly”意为“草率地做决定”。结合后文可知，她的家人不支持，她费了很大力气说服家人，因此这个决定并非“轻易/草率（lightly）”做出的。individually单独地；seriously严肃地；cautiously谨慎地。
questions.supplement:
A(lightly): 语境句：Choosing a university is not a decision to be taken lightly. 固定搭配：take something lightly, tread lightly
B(individually): 语境句：The teacher answered the students' questions individually. 固定搭配：treat individually, wrap individually
C(seriously): 语境句：You need to take your academic studies more seriously. 固定搭配：take seriously, seriously injured
D(cautiously): 语境句：He cautiously approached the stray dog to avoid scaring it. 固定搭配：proceed cautiously, tread cautiously

questions.explanation: 家人不支持她，所以她想尽一切办法去“证明/展示（demonstrate）”自己有多认真。deny否认；admit承认；complain抱怨。
questions.supplement:
A(deny): 语境句：She could not deny the fact that she had made a terrible mistake. 固定搭配：deny doing something, strongly deny
B(admit): 语境句：He finally admitted breaking the window during the game. 固定搭配：admit to doing, freely admit
C(complain): 语境句：Customers began to complain about the poor quality of the service. 固定搭配：complain about, complain of
D(demonstrate): 语境句：The student's excellent project demonstrated his deep understanding of the subject. 固定搭配：demonstrate an ability, demonstrate clearly

questions.explanation: 句中的but表转折，后文是“不去做任何不恰当(inappropriate)的事”，因此前文承诺做的事应当是“恰当的（proper）”，与inappropriate形成反义对应。
questions.supplement:
A(proper): 语境句：It is important to wear proper clothes for a formal interview. 固定搭配：proper behavior, in a proper way
B(expensive): 语境句：Living in the city center can be extremely expensive. 固定搭配：expensive taste, prohibitively expensive
C(complex): 语境句：The scientist proposed a new theory to explain the complex phenomenon. 固定搭配：complex structure, complex issue
D(conventional): 语境句：He prefers conventional medical treatments to alternative therapies. 固定搭配：conventional wisdom, conventional method

questions.explanation: 上文提到她做出了各种努力与承诺，副词Eventually（最终）暗示结果是好的，家人不得不“尊重/接受（respect）”她的决定。reject拒绝；oppose反对；clarify澄清。
questions.supplement:
A(reject): 语境句：The board decided to reject the proposal due to a lack of funds. 固定搭配：reject an offer, firmly reject
B(respect): 语境句：We should respect the diverse cultural backgrounds of our classmates. 固定搭配：respect a decision, show respect for
C(oppose): 语境句：Many local residents strongly oppose the building of the new factory. 固定搭配：oppose a plan, strongly oppose
D(clarify): 语境句：Could you please clarify your main point in the last paragraph? 固定搭配：clarify a situation, seek to clarify

questions.explanation: 后文说她“从不试图向他们隐瞒任何事”，说明她在学习过程中让家人“参与（involved）”其中。protect保护；threaten威胁；cheat欺骗。
questions.supplement:
A(involved): 语境句：The teacher involved all the students in the group discussion. 固定搭配：be involved in, get involved
B(protected): 语境句：The rare birds are strictly protected by local environmental laws. 固定搭配：protect from, highly protected
C(threatened): 语境句：The heavy storm threatened to destroy the coastal village. 固定搭配：feel threatened, threaten to do
D(cheated): 语境句：He was expelled from school because he cheated on the final exam. 固定搭配：cheat on, cheat out of

questions.explanation: 句意：如果家人理解Ruqaia做这件事的“动机（motive）”，他们就更有可能理解她所做事情的优势。profile简介；routine常规；habit习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(profile): 语境句：You need to update your online profile to attract more employers. 固定搭配：keep a low profile, raise someone's profile
B(motive): 语境句：The police are still trying to find out the motive for the crime. 固定搭配：hidden motive, ulterior motive
C(routine): 语境句：Exercising every morning has become part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
D(habit): 语境句：Reading before bed is a good habit that benefits your mind. 固定搭配：develop a habit, kick a habit

questions.explanation: 她完成了这个项目，并接着去开罗大学“注册/就读（register）”。register in意为“在……注册/入学”。teach教书；consume消耗；invest投资。
questions.supplement:
A(teach): 语境句：She plans to teach English in a remote village after graduation. 固定搭配：teach oneself, teach someone a lesson
B(consume): 语境句：These new LED bulbs consume much less electricity than traditional ones. 固定搭配：consume energy, time-consuming
C(register): 语境句：You must register online before you can attend the conference. 固定搭配：register for, register in
D(invest): 语境句：The government decided to invest heavily in public transportation. 固定搭配：invest in, invest heavily

questions.explanation: 文章主旨及第一段均指出这是关于妇女和女童的教育问题，因此她回馈社会的方式是开设一所专注于“女性（females）”的学校。males男性；seniors长者；adults成年人。
questions.supplement:
A(males): 语境句：In this species of bird, the males are more brightly colored than the females. 固定搭配：adult males, dominant males
B(females): 语境句：The organization aims to empower females in rural and impoverished areas. 固定搭配：adult females, empower females
C(seniors): 语境句：The community center offers free health check-ups for local seniors. 固定搭配：high school seniors, care for seniors
D(adults): 语境句：This movie is suitable for both children and adults. 固定搭配：young adults, grown adults

questions.explanation: 她帮助女性在社区找到“体面的（decent）”工作，这是对社会的回馈。back-breaking繁重折骨的；time-consuming耗时的；shameless无耻的，均含贬义或不符语境。
questions.supplement:
A(back-breaking): 语境句：Farming without modern machinery used to be back-breaking work. 固定搭配：back-breaking labor, back-breaking tasks
B(time-consuming): 语境句：Filling out all these complicated forms is incredibly time-consuming. 固定搭配：time-consuming process, highly time-consuming
C(shameless): 语境句：His shameless behavior at the formal dinner shocked everyone present. 固定搭配：shameless lie, shameless self-promotion
D(decent): 语境句：Everyone deserves a decent place to live and a stable job. 固定搭配：decent job, decent living

questions.explanation: Ruqaia的故事促使当地社区“承认/认识到（acknowledge）”教育对妇女和女童职业规划的重要性。ignore忽视；maintain维持；restore恢复。
questions.supplement:
A(ignore): 语境句：You cannot simply ignore the doctor's advice if you want to recover. 固定搭配：ignore reality, completely ignore
B(maintain): 语境句：It is vital to maintain a balanced diet for good health. 固定搭配：maintain a relationship, maintain order
C(acknowledge): 语境句：The government must acknowledge the severity of the environmental crisis. 固定搭配：acknowledge the importance, acknowledge defeat
D(restore): 语境句：The ancient temple was carefully restored to its original glory. 固定搭配：restore order, restore confidence

questions.explanation: 句子的主语是Lu Qi，谓语动词是announce，两者是被动关系（被宣布）；时间状语是last month，故使用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was announced): 语境句：The winner of the competition was announced on national television. 固定搭配：be announced to the public, officially announced. 原词announce其它变形：announcement(n. 宣布), announcer(n. 播音员)

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配。praise sb. for sth. 表示“因某事而赞扬某人”，此处使用其被动形式的过去分词作状语 (being) highly praised for...
questions.supplement: 正确形(for): 语境句：She was widely praised for her brave actions during the fire. 固定搭配：be praised for, be famous for.

questions.explanation: 此处为非限制性定语从句，先行词是the first Chinese person，在从句中作achievements的定语，表示“他的成就”，故填关系代词whose。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whose): 语境句：I have a friend whose father is a famous scientist. 固定搭配：whose name, whose work.

questions.explanation: drought意为“干旱”，是可数名词。根据后面的系动词are可知，主语需用复数形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(droughts): 语境句：Severe droughts have ruined the crops in the southern region. 固定搭配：severe droughts, prolonged droughts. 原词drought其它变形：drought-stricken(adj. 受旱灾影响的)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。across the globe是固定表达，意为“在世界各地/全球范围内”，globe前必须加定冠词the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the): 语境句：People across the globe are working together to combat climate change. 固定搭配：across the globe, around the globe.

questions.explanation: 此处需要一个副词来修饰形容词possible。whole的副词形式是wholly，意为“完全地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(wholly): 语境句：The new policy was not wholly successful, but it helped somewhat. 固定搭配：wholly possible, wholly responsible. 原词whole其它变形：whole(adj. 整个的), wholeness(n. 完整)

questions.explanation: Lu与assist之间是主动关系，且前面的句子已有谓语动词has led，此处需用现在分词(doing)作伴随状语或结果状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(assisting): 语境句：The volunteer spent her summer assisting doctors in a rural clinic. 固定搭配：assist sb in doing sth, assist with. 原词assist其它变形：assistance(n. 帮助), assistant(n. 助手)

questions.explanation: gain为及物动词，后需接名词作宾语。recognize的名词形式是recognition，gain recognition意为“获得认可”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(recognition): 语境句：Her research finally gained international recognition after years of hard work. 固定搭配：gain recognition, win recognition. 原词recognize其它变形：recognizable(adj. 可辨认的), unrecognized(adj. 未被承认的)

questions.explanation: 根据前文的has increased（增加了）以及连词and可知，此处表示职责变得“更重了”，需用比较级heavier。
questions.supplement: 正确形(heavier): 语境句：The rain grew heavier as we drove further into the mountains. 固定搭配：grow heavier, much heavier. 原词heavy其它变形：heavily(adv. 沉重地), heaviness(n. 沉重)

questions.explanation: centers and forums与design之间是被动关系，且此处作后置定语，相当于which are designed to...，故用过去分词designed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(designed): 语境句：This program is specially designed to help teenagers build confidence. 固定搭配：be designed to do sth, be designed for. 原词design其它变形：designer(n. 设计师), designation(n. 指定)
